8.3.name: 8.03.md
8.3.text:
```cpp
while (cin >> i) /* ... */
```

When the stream encounters a system level failure, an IO failure or the stream reaches the end-of-file. Each of these errors turn on the following bits respectively: badbit, failbit and enfbit. Given that the failbit is also turned on when either the badbit or the eofbit is truned on, this while loop test for the condition !cin.fail(). (p. 313) That is, it terminates when !cin.fail() returns 0.
